systems.tiers: Citizens report online; to the day of the statement 43,960 missing-vehicle reports, 16,474 against property, 226 missing persons and 57 against the person; a stolen-vehicle inquiry feature added in September 2024

note: No fact: the platform is a public reporting channel, a noted class. The police headquarters says the criminal case begins with a report made at the police stations spread across the country or through the platform, and does not say how a station records the report it takes.
